name: All in One Accessibility®
description: All in One Accessibility widget improves Drupal website ADA compliance and browser experience for ADA, WCAG 2.1, Section 508, and other standards.
project_description:
Drupal Accessibility Widget - All in One Accessibility® integrates directly into Drupal 8, 9, 10, 11 and adds a customizable accessibility toolbar to the site's interface. The widget offers more than 90 assistive features ; Supporting re-defined profiles for visitors with visual, motor, cognitive, dyslexia, and learning disabilities, even for elderly individuals. 

 It helps Drupal accessibility developers to address common usability barriers aligned with WCAG 2.1, 2.2, ADA, EAA, Section 508, California Unruh, France RGAA, European EAA EN 301 549, UK Equality Act (EA), Spain UNE 139803:2012, Australian DDA, Israeli Standard 5568, Ontario AODA, Canada ACA, German BITV, Brazilian Inclusion Law (LBI 13.146/2015), JIS X 8341 (Japan), Italian Stanca Act, Indian RPwD Act, Switzerland DDA and other web accessibility standards .

 This AI accessibility widget is suitable for higher education, public sector, enterprise organizations, healthcare, nonprofits, and small businesses, digital agencies using Drupal who want to enhance accessibility without complex custom development. It supports compliance goals, improves user experience, and helps organizations take a proactive step toward digital inclusion.

 Back to top 

 KEY FEATURES: 
 
 It supports 190+ languages , suitable for global and multilingual Drupal environments , and automatically adapts to language settings. 
 
 It is compatible with multisite Drupal installations, allowing configuration per site, also a free license for staging or testing environment. 
 Quick two minutes installation. 
 AI assisted enhancements including alternative text remediation, screen reader (voice can be customized) are the key features. 
 Voice Navigation, Dictionary, Virtual Keyboard, Accessibility Profiles, Sign language Libras (Brazilian Portuguese) Custom Widget Color, Icon size, Position, Custom trigger setup, GA4 Tracking, Adobe Accessibility Analytics Tracking, custom accessibility statement link are the top features. 
 Accessibility dashboard includes managing setting for customization of widget including size, icon, colors, position, user access management, widget open / close sound preferences, and more. 
 10 Days Free trial available. 
 
 Here's a comprehensive drupal accessibility module guide .

 Back to top 

 This Drupal WCAG accessibility module can be helpful for: 
 
 Universities and colleges managing campus-wide Drupal installations 
 Municipal, state, and federal government websites working toward Section 508 alignment 
 Healthcare providers maintaining large content libraries 
 Enterprises using Drupal for marketing, portals, and intranet platforms 
 Nonprofits needing accessible digital experiences on a budget 
 Small and mid-size businesses seeking baseline accessibility features 
 
 Back to top 

 Why does the module fit the Drupal Ecosystem? 
 
 Works well with Drupal's structured content model 
 Compatible with custom Drupal themes and layout builders 
 Does not disrupt existing modules or workflows 
 Scales easily across multisite environments 
 
 Back to top 

 SECURITY & PRIVACY NOTES 
 
 The All in One Accessibility® module follows several data and application security practices, including ISO 9001:2015 & ISO 27001:2013, GDPR, CCPA, COPPA, HIPAA, and SOC 2 Type II. 
 Skynet Technologies USA LLC is an organizational member of IAAP and of W3C. 
 This helps to maintain accessibility features while respecting privacy, data protection, and security expectations required in many U.S. and international sectors such as healthcare, education, and public services.
 
 No personal data is intentionally stored by the module itself. 
 Site owners are responsible for reviewing their own compliance requirements. 
 
 Back to top 

 LIMITATIONS 
 
 The widget enhances accessibility and usability but is not a full replacement for manual WCAG remediation. 
 Some advanced features require a commercial subscription. 
 Automated fixes may not address all accessibility issues.
